reviews.text: On your worst day, these guys are your best friend. Can’t speak highly enough of the staff - thank you for helping Ron and me, we’re so grateful for the care.

Hi Paola! 

Thank you for the five stars, it really brightens our day!

We're so glad you chose Scout Veterinary Urgent Care for your pet's visit.

We're always here when you need us <3

Take Care,
The Scout team

We had an excellent experience here (at least as excellent as it can be when your furbaby needs urgent care!). The technician who helped us was extremely friendly and patient, even though our 10 month old dog was wary and barking at her. We saw Dr. Patsavas, and he was as nice as could be and walked us through everything clearly. Their billing was easy to understand, and our final cost came in below their initial estimate.

Would definitely use again, even though we obviously hope not to need to!

We brought our dog to Scout Vet after he started suffering from vomiting and diarrhea, and we couldn't be more grateful for the care he received. The entire staff was incredibly kind and took the time to thoroughly address all of our concerns. I’ve already recommended Scout to my neighbor, and I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a compassionate veterinary team!

Very friendly staff and helped my dog out so much! I love going here whenever my primary vet isn't available and my dog needs to be seen sooner. I've been here twice already and loved each time I have gone.

Oh my gosh 10/10 team! We came in on a holiday evening with no appointment and were seen almost immediately. They explained every step clearly, answered all our questions, and handled our kitten, Molly, with so much kindness and care. We are so grateful to have them in the West Loop!

We brought our beloved cat to Scout Urgent Care in the West Loop on June 17. Sadly, she was diagnosed with a stroke and lung cancer, and we had to make the heartbreaking decision to let her go.

During one of the most painful moments of our lives, the veterinarian and staff treated us with extraordinary kindness, compassion, and respect. They carefully explained everything, understood how deeply we were hurting, and never made us feel rushed. They allowed us to stay with our girl for as long as we needed, both before the procedure and afterward, so we could say goodbye in our own time.

We will always be grateful for the gentleness and dignity they showed our little girl, and for the compassion they gave us when we needed it most. I cannot recommend Scout Urgent Care West Loop  highly enough. Thank you

Scout Veterinary Urgent Care in the West Loop is great! They were able to accommodate us for a same-day-pre-holiday-weekend-last-minute appointment for our cat. The receptionist was very helpful and we were able to be seen right away. The tech and vet were great at explaining our cat’s medical issue and were very efficient in taking care of her both at the clinic and in providing their post-care notes for our reference. The clinic was very clean and comfortable, and it was nice to have the soft music in the exam room. We would definitely go there again and our cat would too, she just won’t admit it. ;) Thanks so much!

I couldn’t say enough positive things. The staff is kind, patient, caring, and so knowledgeable. They have taken incredible care of all of my pets. Strongly recommend for any medical needs. Dr. Angela Smith was incredible.

My kitty Clawdia recently developed a case of conjunctivitis, and I'm beyond grateful that Scout was able to see us day of.

The clinic is really nice; super clean and peaceful. The cost was very reasonable, and they are transparent about pricing.  But most importantly, the staff is wonderful.
Felicia the vet tech was so sweet with Clawdia, and her overall kindness made me feel calmer.  Dr Rivera is an incredible vet. She was extremely thorough, gentle, and explained things in a way that my frazzled brain could compute. You can tell they genuinely care about animals and your baby is in loving hands.

Scout is the perfect place when you can't see your regular vet and want to avoid the high cost and stress at the emergency vet.Thank you Dr Rivera for taking care of my girl!

I had a good experience with Scout. My fur baby senior cat Lucky was well taken care of. The staff is great and thorough in their care and attention to Lucky. Pet care is as expensive as human care in some cases. That's why I gave only 4 stars.

Dr Monick and all the techs  were very patient and kind to my nervous dog. The clinic was very clear and up-front with a cost estimate and talked me through each item. My dog was feeling better by the time we got home!
My experience at Scout was very positive. The clinic had an opening after just an hour. It was calm, clean, and my concerns were addressed immediately and thoroughly.

Hi there Antonio 

Thank you so much for the 5-star rating. We truly appreciate your support! 

Our team is grateful for the opportunity to care for pets and their people when they need us. Thank you for choosing Scout Veterinary Urgent Care.

Take Care,
The Scout team

Thank you Scout Vet for taking such excellent care of our dog Zetti late on a Sunday afternoon. She had a sudden breathing/GI issue after a run and we were concerned for bloat or serious airway obstruction. We were seen right away by Dr. Meghan Rivera and her excellent vet tech (I am so sorry I am forgetting her name at the moment!). All members of the care team treated Zetti compassionately and with the appropriate level of concern and care. She received X-rays to rule out dangerous etiologies of her symptoms, and those were read within 1 hour. In the meantime, she received antinausea and pain medication to alleviate her ongoing symptoms. Her work up results and next step options were explained in full, and we felt completely understood and heard. Treatment price was reasonable, especially for the high quality of care. We were able to take Zetti home that night and she is much more comfortable after having been seen by the Scout team. Thank you all!
The staff is very friendly and helpful. The vet that helped me, Dr. Smith was as attentive, knowledgeable about my pet’s ear infection.

Dr. Smith and Felicia were absolutely wonderful! I brought my cat in after a possible exposure to lilies, and they immediately helped ease my anxiety. They treated my baby with so much love, patience, and care, which meant so much to me while I was worried about him.

They took the time to explain the different tests we could do, what each one would tell us, provided estimates upfront, and helped me understand what would be best for my cat without making me feel pressured. I really appreciated how compassionate, informative, and reassuring they were throughout the entire visit. I’m so grateful to both of them for taking such great care of Mozzie and giving him a lil goodie bag to enjoy at home ❤️🐾
Good experience with the doctor while there but nobody ever followed up with me or checked in following his appointment/next day which is not the best feeling.

I want to thank the Scout team for such an incredible experience and amazing care for my kittens. I rescued three kittens suddenly and was able to get them thorough, same-day care with the Scout team, who guided me through all my questions and concerns about how to care for them. I had a wonderful experience and would highly recommend this team.
I really appreciate the fact that you can get an appointment rather than waiting for hours once you arrive. They were very nice, knowledgeable and compassionate.

They were Great with our Lexi( Adult Female Pit Terrier)
Kind and Patient. We'll be adding onto the Scouts Vet. UC. We'll be introducing the team to Our Maverick ( Adult Male Cat, we had to remove his back right leg from a break playing too much on top of his Sister's Dog Cage. Its been 3yrs I  believe since that surgery for him. But he needs to be check on  by this Scouts Team. Lexi is Improving and she plays, it looks like she lost some yrs off her Legs!! She Using her Launch Pad like she use too. Not Marvel Fast but Fast enough. Thanks Team
My first visit and everyone was wonderful caring and explained in detail. Love this place!

Hi there Ming! 

We really appreciate the 5-star rating. It means a lot to know you had a positive experience with our team.

Thank you for choosing Scout Veterinary Urgent Care and for taking a moment to show your support. We’re grateful to be here for pets and their people when care is needed.

Take Care,
The Scout team

After I found my cat distressed and breathing heavily and my regular vet was unable to see him, I took him to Scout. I'm so glad I did. They got him in right away and were compassionate and communicative throughout.

Dr. Rivera and Felicia both made a very stressful situation better than it might otherwise have been. They kept me informed of everything they were doing and reviewed x-ray results with me, which I appreciated. When my cat needed to be transported to a 24/7 facility that could monitor him overnight, Dr. Rivera called ahead to talk to their staff and get an estimate so we weren't walking in blind.

If we're ever in the same situation (although I really hope not), I would absolutely take our furballs back to Scout.

This team here is incredible!  Brought my Dachschund in as he was throwing up and had Diarrhea, as well as very lethargic.  Nurse Amanda and Dr. Rivera took care of him like he was their own. Bonus points for sitting on the floor and cuddling my Doxie!   Everyone took the time to explain what was happening at every step and made sure I understood before proceeding.

Scout West Loop took excellent care of my 2 year old Rhodesian Ridgeback-- German Shephard pup Asha. We were at the park and she started acting strange. She must have got bitten by a spider or maybe bee sting...We left, and by the time we got home she threw up, had hives all over her body, laid down and wouldn't get up. I called her vet, who couldn't get her in for an appointment. They gave me Scout West Loop's number. Scout was able to get her in immediately. When we arrived, Asha was in bad shape and was in obvious severe discomfort. They took great care of her, and I can't thank them enough for their help. Also, the price was very fair, as some urgent care facilities can be quite expensive. Thank you, Scout West Loop! Asha is doing great!
Appointments were available when nothing else was open. Staff were warm and professional. Would certainly go back for more care if needed.

Five stars for Scout! We brought our little dog here after a scary scare with something he ingested. The staff was incredibly courteous and wonderful during a stressful time. We really appreciate your hard work and care!

They were awesome! I had called three other vets before and none had availability. I was hesitant to come here because I thought it would cost an arm and a leg but it was actually an extremely fair price and I could tell our dog was well taken care of. 5 stars!

We had just moved back to Chicago and needed a vet asap. My husband and I were expecting a very long wait in the waiting room and a bill close to $800. What a pleasant surprise to be in and out in an hour and a vet bill that was equal to our established vets office in Michigan. I cannot express enough the level of kindness Hazel received. The Dr. sat on the floor to be at Hazel’s level. The offices are extremely clean and the staff is amazing. They play soft spa like music which adds to the peace and serenity of the atmosphere. Visits are by appointment only which is highly unusual for an urgent care vet but very welcomed! We could not stop talking about what a pleasant visit it was.
1000% recommend Scout!!!
Everyone was amazing. Great experience at a hard time… our dog needed staples after a dog bite. Thank you.
Always gets me in same day. Always friendly. Always very transparent about prices before proceeding with anything. Would recommend in urgent situations!
Made same-day appt for my cat. People were so genuinely nice and great w my pet. Highly recommend!

I thought my pup had a tick but wasn't sure so I wanted confirmation and help with removal. We were traveling to Chicago by car so I found them online on our drive and made an appointment easily on the website. We were seen immediately on arrival and confirmed not a tick but a mole. No charge for the visit. I did not think this kind of service existed anymore!
Everyone was so kind and took great care of my dog. They were able to fit us in on a Saturday within 2 hours of calling and helped identify the issue with my dog. We had a great experience here!

This is the kind of place that you never want to go, but if you go they are super supportive, they give you clear information, they stay in the budget that they told you, and they take great care of our pups. I have been twice and both times I was scared and worried about my dog, and both times they did a great job. Thanks!

I recently brought my dog, Desza, in to have her paw checked and to update some of her vaccines. Overall, the facility itself is very nice — clean, modern, and conveniently located. Having a parking lot directly next to the building was also a huge plus and made the visit easier.

The staff at the front were friendly and welcoming, and it felt like they were expecting us when we arrived, which made check-in smooth. I worked with two different staff members, including Hannah, who was especially gentle and patient with Desza. Since Desza gets very nervous at the vet, I really appreciated Hannah trying to keep her calm and not make the experience more stressful for her.

Working with the doctor was overall easy, but the experience was different from what I’m personally used to. I tend to value detailed explanations, reassurance, and confidence from a veterinarian, especially when something concerning is happening with my dog. Since Desza is my whole world and this issue was new and worrying to me, I was hoping for a little more confidence and communication around what was going on, the treatment process, and what to expect moving forward.

I do want to give grace knowing it was the day after a holiday and urgent care environments can be very busy. At the same time, because this is an emergency/urgent care facility, I was surprised that answers weren’t more immediate and that lab work needed to be sent out with a 3–5 day wait for results. As a pet owner dealing with something concerning, that part was frustrating and unexpected.

Overall, the staff was kind, the facility was great, and I’m hopeful for good follow-up once the lab results come back. I think stronger reassurance, communication, and confidence from the medical side would have made the experience feel much better for me as a worried dog owner.

After an extremely stressful situation with our little Chihuahua, this clinic was absolutely amazing.

The staff was incredibly fast, kind, and welcoming from the moment we arrived. The front desk team was compassionate and reassuring, the veterinary assistant was wonderful, and the veterinarian herself was attentive, caring, and professional.

What impressed us the most is that they even stayed after closing time to wait for our arrival after we explained the emergency situation over the phone. That level of compassion meant everything to us in that moment.

You can genuinely feel that the people here truly love animals and care about what they do. That kind of energy matters so much when you come in scared and worried about your pet.

Thankfully, our dog was examined quickly and we finally felt like we were in the right place.

Very grateful for the care and kindness we received. ❤️

Thank you to the staff at SCOUT for taking care of my baby!! I was able to get an appointment after hours, easily, they were so nice and caring with my dog and we were both really nervous/worried. Special thank you to vet tech Felicia, she loved my Oso and to Dr. Heaver she was so helpful! Thank you Scout!

Do not bring your pet here. I brought my cat in Saturday with severe constipation. Dr. Heaver ordered X-rays which she said showed the possibility of megacolon. She sent us home with just some fluids and a prescription that could only be filled online, meaning at least a 5 day delivery time.

I watched my cat suffer horribly for the next 40 hours, unable to eat, pacing, straining to have a BM, crying in pain. I was desperate and called another urgent care vet. They said, sure, we have that medication in stock but we have to do an exam first.  I took my cat there, they did another X-ray. This second vet showed me the X-ray; there was an enormous mass of stool that would never be able to pass through his body. It has to be manually extracted. This second vet immediately ordered pain medication, enemas and hospitalization.

This was a situation that required hospitalization and Dr. Heaver at Scout did not see it. This was not a ha ha very funny constipation. It was life threatening. My cat could have died of a rupture. My cat suffered needlessly for another 40 hours.

This was malpractice on Dr. Heaver's part and I cannot believe I had to pay more than $700 for it.

Do not bring your pet to Scout. You have been warned.
Scout was a fantastic urgent care experience. Our dog was able to be same day, in a calm environment much better than any emergency visit I’ve had before.

I’m super greatful for this place. My
Dog unfortunately passed away and they were the best and sweetest people
To help my baby boy. They are very kind and considerate. They made sure we were received our dogs ashes safe and sound. They even send us flowers for his passing. I’m so grateful there is good clinics out there like this one. Wonderful humans with a good heart. I’ve never seen one like it.

Avoiding the ER we went to scout. Medvet recommended them.  Best decision ever.  They went above and beyond,  answered all my questions,  cleaned up my pup Ellie and gave her glue stitches. They are great for follow ups. The place is so beautiful,  clean,  very calm and the staff is great,  the vet was super sweet and sympathetic. Pricing was reasonable and I love that they work with you as well.  I would definitely go back.  Thank you Scout

Thank you to everyone at Scout Veterinary! My family and I are very grateful for how kind and gentle everyone were in the last moments of my dogs life. Unfortunately we had to put him down. He was the sweetest puppy.
The scout team were able to see to my sick cat very quickly, outlined in detail what could possibly be the problem while offering support and being incredibly welcoming and supportive.
Great service! We take our dogs to Thrive for all their needs. Friendly people and great staff. Our dogs love them.

I’m so glad I found Scout for my little girl, Frankie.  She developed swelling and pain on her bottom and I couldn’t get her into her primary vet.  I went to Scout and they were wonderful! They got us in right away, did a thorough examination, answered all my questions (there were many), and gave us pain meds.   Dr. Roundy was so gentle and patient with my tiny, nervous girl.  The rest of the staff were so kind and helpful.  I highly recommend Scout and feel grateful to have such a great facility so close!
The staff were very helpful, pleasant, and patient with myself and my puppy, as this was our first time in urgent care.
Such a friendly staff! Were able to help me identify a cut that became infected in my pups paw and clean it with ease. Very kind and transparent!

This place is wonderful. They were able to help me with my cat Prince. I was very nervous about his hinny area, but they were able to listen and answer my questions. They tend to my baby and he is felling better.
Highly qualified professionals. Explained the situation clearly. Gave me time to process.
I'm very grateful for the Scout team, they took in our dog fluffy same day and she means the world to us so I appreciate the kindness and proffesionalism 😁

We had a really positive experience here from beginning to end - I especially appreciated being able to make an appointment (booked around 8am for a 10am spot).  It's a nice new facility and everyone we met was very professional and kind.  We had xrays and a blood test, then subcutaneous fluids - all handled smoothly!  Dr Roundy explained everything clearly and sent us home with clear instructions and enough medication to get through a few days while we waited for the RX to be filled at chewy.  Thank you all!

Dr. Hill and Dr. Gomez and all the wonderful techs and front office staff were so helpful. Answered all my 1000 questions without making me feel annoying or insane. So reasonable too and were willing to work with me for everything for my dog. I appreciate them so much and if anything comes up and is an emergency I know exactly where I’m going. Finch is feeling better already!

Hi Giorgio! 

Thank you for the 5 stars! We’re glad you had a positive experience and truly appreciate your support. We’re here anytime you need us.

Take Care,
The Scout Team

Whenever something unexpected happens I am so grateful Scout is open to help! They are always so kind and responsive. They helped me navigate a scary situation where my dog got bitten by another dog. I will continue to use them as my veterinary urgently care.
They were very professional very kind and understanding

I brought in my dog Minnie who was diagnosed with pancreatitis. Minnie was vomiting and our primary vet was just about to close, so Scout was recommended. We were able to be seen within a few hours that same day. The staff was so friendly and Minnie was well taken care of! I had to bring her back in a few days later and they made the process so easy! She is recovering well and I’m so thankful I brought her to Scout! Both Dr. Rivera and Dr. Monick are wonderful! I wouldn’t hesitate to bring her back!

This veterinary urgent care was a lovely experience from start to finish. As soon as you enter, the place looks very welcoming with decorative plants, benches for sitting, and a person at the front desk. There were also books to read, and my partner and I took a look at some of them because they were too funny! An added bonus is that, at least when I went, the urgent care lacked any sort of strong scent, so you already feel more comfortable with the cleanliness of the clinic. Both the technician and doctor held my 3 month old kitties with concern and care, and I couldn’t appreciate this team more. Thank you SCOUT! I will definitely be returning.

Our dogs primary vet recommended Scout, as they could not fit us in when our golden, Mabel, was sick,  Very professional and took great care of our her. It was easy to get an appointment and they saw us immediately when we arrived. They walked us through what they wanted to do and why, which made us comfortable.  Would absolutely bring either of our dogs here again.

The team at Scout are amazing. We originally got to know them when my pupster had a neuro situation and the thoroughness of their examination, the care and the personal follow-ups as we worked through treatment was unbelievable. They’re our go to for any vet needs outside general wellness (although I wish we could see them for everything).
It feels like a family practice and not a corporation which is an amazing achievement and says everything about the calibre of the people who work there.

Was able to make a same day appointment for my sweet girl (older cat). The staff and doctor were all welcoming, kind and professional. Walked out feeling much better about my sweet girl’s health and with clear next steps to continue her care.
Went in with my cat for x-rays and blood work. The team was so sweet, super helpful and did not pressure me to make one choice over another. I would highly recommend this urgent care!
The staff was so thorough and helpful! Really reasonable.

Like most, me and my kitty hate the vet. We appreciate their work obviously, but it is a nightmare scenario every time.

That said, my experience with Scout stood out because of how well they managed all that. It felt different than my other experiences Not to mention, the inspiring amount of love and compassion they have for the creatures in their care.

We felt so well taken care of! And when I followed up weeks later for some help with a prescription issue they helped me so quickly, I was genuinely astonished.

May the universe smile brightly on all the souls working there!
compassionate, transparent, and timely.

Best experience at an urgent care for my Labrador dog! They welcomed us so calmly and immediately made our puppy feel safe and sound. They let him sniff everything before going near him, and the technician and Dr. Rivera treated him with such care. They informed us of all treatment options and pricing was upfront and very reasonable for an urgent care day-of. Highly recommend and will definitely go back if necessary.

Scout has come to the rescue twice now when we weren't able to get an appointment at our regular vet. The staff is SO patient and compassionate, and helped make a very difficult and painful experience for us go smoothly and gently. I am endlessly grateful to their staff and can't recommend them enough.

We had an emergency visit to Scout, we we couldn’t have been happier. The office is beautiful and it was easy to book online. The advice we received from Dr. Rivera was precise and exactly what our dog needed. Our dog is large and does not do well at the vet, and the staff was able to handle him very well. Pricing was extremely reasonable, and they have parking onsite. This is a great emergency or regular vet option.

We needed to get our pet seen quickly when our regular vet couldn’t accommodate us, and I really appreciated how easy it was to get an appointment here the same day. We were seen promptly, and the doctor was compassionate and caring, especially as we received a difficult diagnosis.
What I didn’t love about the experience was that I had been very clear up front about the services and tests I did and did not want — I only wanted what was medically necessary. While I thought that had been agreed upon with the vet, the vet tech came in afterward and offered several additional services that I had specifically declined. It felt like unnecessary upselling, which was disappointing.
Another area for improvement would be their medication policy. We were prescribed two medications totaling nearly $400 over two visits, but our pet’s condition changed quickly and we didn’t end up needing any of them. When I called to ask about a possible credit or return, I was told they couldn’t accept them back and was advised to donate them to a shelter instead. However, the other veterinary hospital we visited offers a credit for unused medications filled through their in-house pharmacy, so I wish that had been an option here. While I understand there are important safety protocols around medication returns, other veterinary hospitals are able to offer credit while still maintaining proper standards. Since similar establishments can manage this process responsibly, I hope Scout will consider adopting a comparable approach in the future. It would provide more flexibility and support for clients in situations like ours.
All in all, if you need to get in quickly or are in a pinch, this clinic is a good option and you’ll be treated kindly. However, if possible, I’d stick with your regular vet who knows your pet’s history and may be less likely to push additional costs. They may also be more flexible with medication returns or credits, which can help avoid unnecessary costs.

Our primary veterinarian recommended Scout Urgent Care to us when they didn't have any openings for a same-day appointment. Our cat was not doing well and really had us worried. We were relieved that Scout was able to see us that afternoon. Everyone was very nice. The process was easy. The facilities were clean and we appreciated being able to park in their parking lot. Most importantly, the veterinarian was able to get us some medicine for our cat which led to a speedy recovery and allowed us to breathe a sigh of relief. Thanks to everyone at Scout for helping our little buddy!

Hi Matt,

Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! It means a great deal to know that your experience with Scout left such a positive impression. Our team works hard to make urgent care for pets feel clear, compassionate, and a little easier in moments that are often stressful, and we’re grateful you chose us when you needed support.

If you ever find yourself in another unexpected situation with your pet, we’ll be here to help.

Take Care,
The Scout team

I just wanted to give a shout out to Scout Veterinary Urgent Care. I wasn’t aware they were in the neighborhood until my regular vet recommended them when I couldn’t get in with them.

They are super friendly, thorough and caring. They had me and my cat in and out quickly with prescription eye drops and are very reasonably priced as well. They even sent her home with some new toys and treats!

I highly recommend them when your regular vet is closed but you don’t need true emergency care.
Great staff and amazing service! As a first time puppy owner they handled my situation perfectly, which was a moment of crisis for me and my puppy.
So grateful for Scout!! They did a thorough job assessing my dog when he was having eye issues out of the blue. I left feeling very confident with his treatment plan.
Wonderful experience! Got us in the same day and was able to help my cat feel better right away. Plus the facility is beautiful and CLEAN. Would recommend to any pet parents!

It’s never a great experience having an emergency for a pet but the west loop scout team made it as easy and as least stressful as possible. Dr. Rivera was very thorough in explaining the situation as it was new to us as well as answering all our questions. Was it expensive? yes. But it was an urgent medical need and we could not wait until the weekday to try and get into our regular vet. Our cat got the medical attention he needed and that’s what matters. I hope we don’t have to use them anytime soon but I’m glad we have an urgent care so close by that I trust.

Hi Patricia, 

Hi there,

Thank you for the 5 stars! We’re so glad you chose Scout and appreciate your trust in our team to care for your pet. We’ll be here whenever the unexpected comes up again.

Take Care,
The Scout team

I’ve gone to scout several times with my cats and have always received wonderful compassionate care. They have definitely seen me during my most stressful moments and were very communicative throughout the whole process. I have had good experiences with multiple vets but my last was with Dr. Roundy who was very sweet and knowledgeable and got my cat situated for ER transfer. Wonderful urgent care. Also there’s parking.

Hi there! 

Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We’re grateful you chose Scout and are glad to know your experience left such a positive impression. Our team is always here to make pet care feel a little easier—especially in those unexpected moments.

Take Care,
The Scout team
Very good experience for what we needed. The nurse and staff were professional and made us feel reassured that things would be okay in time of a crisis.

I was able to make a last minute appointment for my dog who was bitten badly by a stray dog.  They were able to schedule me in within 2 hours of calling as I was worried about finding a place after calling a half dozen animal hospitals.  The staff is extremely friendly and accommodating and the veterinarian is very knowledgeable and has a great bedside manner and explained everything in detail.  They were also very fair on pricing.  I highly recommend this clinic!

My 14-year-old beagle was instantly weak and falling over. His left front feet were curling and he was in pain.
Our primary vet didn’t have any available appointments – and suggested Scout. They were able to see Maurice right away (booking was easy!) and provided a very thorough examination with medication and a care plan for his IVDD. Dr. Monick is fantastic and explains things clearly and in detail. I felt that Maurice was in the very best hands. She also communicated frequently with our primary vet to make sure that everyone was on the same page.
Excellent service!!!!

I had no idea there was an urgent care place for pets, but my local vet suggested Scout when they couldn’t schedule an appointment for my dog until several days out. It wasn’t an emergency situation, but my dog did need to be treated sooner rather than later. It was very easy to book an appointment with Scout, and they provided excellent care for my dog. They also shared records with my vet, which is great for continuity of care. I’m tempted to go back to Scout for a follow up rather than to my vet.

Dr. Megan Roundy was super helpful in finding out what was wrong with our cat. She was great at explaining his condition and what we would need to do going forward. I also appreciated that the cost of his treatment was discussed up front and there was no push for excessive testing/imaging.

I'm so glad to know about Scout! My dog's primary vet suggested it, as I called when they were about to close on a Friday night. My pup is so distraught when he has ear infections, so there's so way we could wait over a weekend or a few days to get in to his normal vet. I try to avoid the Emergency Vet as he gets extremely stressed. Scout is a great inbetween that I didn't know existed. The price was pretty much the same as my dog's primary vet, which I also appreciated considering ER Vet cost significantly more.

The team was so sweet to my rambunctious old pup. The vet was super helpful and talked me through the best treatment options. He's feeling much much better. Pup and me say thank you Scout WL team!

I've been to two Scout locations and have been blown away each time by how amazing they are. The doctors and techs are confident and have amazing bedside manner. And the front desk is always very pleasant! Brought a kitten here I found to scan for a chip and get tested and it was smooth and painless. Thank you so much!

I am so grateful for Scout! My cat Moonshine was spayed at another clinic on Wednesday and over the holiday weekend started to display signs of infection. It was Sunday and I was scrambling trying to get her seen as soon as possible, wanted to avoid the emergency room and was worried I would have to wait until Tuesday and it could worsen. I actually called the Lincoln Park location and they were able to schedule me SAME DAY at this location about 2 hours after my call. From the front desk to the exam room it was a very relaxing environment, which both Moonshine and I appreciated after the stressful situation. Very clean as well. Everyone was so friendly and helpful. Special thanks to Crystal and Dr. Rivera for a thorough visit. Moonshine got her incision cleaned, put on antibiotics, and they swabbed the bacteria to test in case the infection was more severe. They were thoughtful enough inform me it would be cheaper to bring it into the clinic she was seen at originally for testing as they knew cost was a concern! I am a new pet owner, but I don't think many vets offer to do that. They are about quality over quantity care. I am happy I took Moonshine to Scout and she seems to be on the mends. They even gave a little treat and a toy that she will be happy to play with once she is good to be more active. Thank you  again Scout staff for what you do!
